slides.texte_overlay:
8 signs a man grew up with
no father

1. Self-taught.

He learned to fix things
from videos and mistakes.

2. Close to his mother.

He saw everything she carried.

3. Early responsibility.

He was "the man of the house"
at twelve.

4. Chosen brothers.

His friends became family.

5. Hard on himself.

Nobody told him
"that's good enough."

6. Always learning.

What nobody taught him,
he teaches himself.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. Always learning.

What nobody taught him,
he learns on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
7. Quietly protective.

He checks on everyone.

8. A promise to do better.

For the kids he'll raise.
